set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit [parameter2] family inet address [p.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

unit [parameter2] family [parameter3] ad.explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family, and IP address

parameters.name: unit number
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: address family
parameters.explanation: The address family (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: IP address with mask
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask in CIDR notation

set protocols bgp group [parameter1].explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

parameters.name: group
parameters.explanation: BGP Group name.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: BGP group type

peer-as [parameter2].explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings by specifying the group and peer AS number

parameters.name: peer AS number
parameters.explanation: The autonomous system number of the BGP peer

neighbor [parameter2].explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings by specifying a group and a neighbor IP address

parameters.name: neighbor IP address
parameters.explanation: IP address of the BGP neighbor

family [parameter2] [parameter3].explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings including group and address family

parameters.name: address family
parameters.explanation: Type of address family (e.g., inet)

parameters.name: sub-address family
parameters.explanation: Sub-type of address family (e.g., unicast)

export [parameter2].explanation: Configure BGP protocol to export direct routes from a specified group

parameters.name: export policy
parameters.explanation: Name of the export policy to apply

set policy-options policy-statement [par.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

parameters.name: policy-statement
parameters.explanation: name of the policy statement.

term [parameter2] from protocol [paramet.explanation: Configure policy options to specify the source protocol for a term in a policy statement

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: The protocol to match in the term

term [parameter2] then [parameter3].explanation: Configure a routing policy to accept direct routes

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken (e.g., accept, reject)
